description: Verify a fix the honest way: run the same repro in clean git worktrees of the base ref and the head ref. VERIFIED only when it fails on the base and passes on the head. NOT-REPRODUCED when it passes on the base too, STILL-FAILING when it fails on both, BROKEN-BY-HEAD when the change introduced the failure, ERROR when a run could not complete. Give either a raw command, or a native runner (pytest, go, or auto) with an optional testFile and testName, and reprocheck builds the real pytest or go test command itself. An uncommitted repro or regression test file can be copied into both worktrees with testFile. The report includes a machine readable receipt with the red (base) and green (head) evidence. The working tree is never modified.

baseRef.description: Base ref (the code before the fix), e.g. main or a commit SHA

command.description: The raw repro command to run in both worktrees, e.g. npm test. Omit when runner is given

headRef.description: Head ref (the code with the fix), e.g. HEAD or a branch

repoPath.description: Path to a local git repository

runner.description: Native test runner to use instead of a raw command: pytest, go, or auto (detect from the repo)

setupCommand.description: Optional setup command run in each worktree first, e.g. npm install

testFile.description: Repo-relative path of an uncommitted repro/test file in the working tree to copy into both worktrees

testName.description: A single named test for a native runner, e.g. test_add for pytest or TestAdd for go test

name: run_repro_check
